title: Spec Builder Packaged Sample Roadmap
summary: A customer-facing sample roadmap showing current focus, upcoming work, milestone grouping, and recently completed progress.
description: This sample roadmap container demonstrates how packaged Spec Builder artifacts reference roadmap items, milestones, sprints, presentation preferences, and delivery notes while remaining compatible with minimal roadmap JSON.
